column3: Retains “go for yourself” in the command to Abram.
“Be a blessing” is an imperative rather than the result clause “so that you will be a blessing.”
The one who curses Abram is singular, contrasted with the plural people blessing him; BSB uses “those” for both.
Retains the age expression “a son of seventy-five years.”
Distinguishes the possessions they accumulated from the persons they acquired in Haran, using a separate verb for each.
“The Canaanite” is a singular collective designation rather than the plural “the Canaanites.”
